title: Wiki Live Challenge: Challenging Deep Research Agents with Expert-Level Wikipedia Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge framework to evaluate generated long-form articles against Wikipedia's Neutral Point of View (NPOV) criteria. The evaluation checks for fair representation of viewpoints, avoidance of opinions stated as facts, use of nonjudgmental language, and proportional weighting of opposing views without editorializing.

Qualitative comparison of AI-generated articles against human-written Wikipedia articles to observe the tendency of models to prioritize trending topics, traffic-generating events, and controversies over balanced, comprehensive, and encyclopedic coverage.
